extracted.name: Easy Venison Meatloaf
extracted.description: Ground venison and stuffing are baked together in a meatloaf and topped with barbecue sauce for a hearty meal any day of the week.
ingredient_lines: 1 (6 ounce) package dry stuffing mix (such as Stove Top®)
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Mix venison, stuffing mix, water, onion, 1/4 cup barbecue sauce, eggs, salt, and black pepper together in a large bowl until fully incorporated. Shape venison mixture into a loaf and place in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Spread remaining 1/4 cup barbecue sauce over the top of loaf.
Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink in the center, about 1 hour. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
